selected.rationale: Loss on the webapp->Basket.API edge hangs the synchronous cart/checkout request when no timeout/retry exists, causing checkout availability loss and exposing missing timeout/retry defenses on the most critical user-facing path.
Redis is the basket state store; losing it removes cart persistence and forces basket failure with no fallback, exposing missing recovery/fallback for a critical stateful dependency.

Checkout integration events are published from Basket.API to RabbitMQ; message loss can silently prevent order creation if publisher confirms/retries are absent, exposing a reliability weakness in the checkout event path.

A delay on the RabbitMQ publish propagates into the Basket.API checkout response, revealing whether the event bus dependency is synchronously coupled and lacks a timeout; latency amplification breaks the checkout path.
Loss on the mobile-bff->Ordering.API edge hangs order placement/history for mobile clients without a bounded timeout, exposing missing timeout/retry on a core order path.
Loss on the webapp->Ordering.API edge causes the web order flow to fail or hang if no retry/timeout exists, exposing the same missing-defense pattern on the primary order service.
Catalog is the storefront's main synchronous read path; loss without a timeout makes the product catalog unavailable and can hang page rendering, exposing missing timeout/fallback.
Identity/authentication calls are synchronous and entry-blocking; loss to Identity.API can prevent login/session validation, exposing missing timeout/retry on an auth-critical edge.
